info.name: Qalam Academy - Backend API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the Qalam Academy educational platform backend (Node.js / Express / Mongoose).

## Authentication
Most endpoints require authentication. The backend accepts the JWT via the **`Qalam_Token` httpOnly cookie** (set automatically on login) OR the **`Authorization: Bearer <token>`** header. After running **Login**, the `accessToken` collection variable is populated from the response.

## Language
Send `Accept-Language: ar` or `en` to control localized messages and translated fields. The default is `ar`. Some response messages are raw translation keys (e.g. `Document.fetched`) or hardcoded English strings.

## Roles
- `admin` — full control
- `instructor` — content + own courses
- `student` — cart/orders/progress/reviews

## Base URL
Configure `baseUrl` in the environment (default `http://localhost:5000`).

request.description:
## Purpose
Checks that the API server is up and running.

## Authentication
Not required.

## Responses

**200** - `{"status": "healthy"}`

## Purpose
Creates a new user account and sends a 6-digit OTP to the user's email for verification.

## Authentication
Not required.

## Request
All fields required. Password must be 6-20 chars, contain a letter and a number.

| Field | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| firstName | string | Yes | Min 2, max 30 |
| lastName | string | Yes | Min 2, max 30 |
| email | string | Yes | Valid email |
| phone | string | Yes | International format `^\+?[1-9]\d{9,14}$` |
| country | string | Yes | Min 2, max 100 |
| city | string | Yes | Min 2, max 100 |
| address | string | Yes | Min 5, max 300 |
| password | string | Yes | Min 6, max 20, letter + number |

## Responses
**200** - OTP sent to email. **400** - validation. **409** - duplicate email/phone.

response.name: 200 - Success

request.description:
## Purpose
Logs a verified user in. Sets an httpOnly cookie `Qalam_Token` and returns the JWT in the response body.

## Authentication
Not required.

## Request
| Field | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| email | string | Yes | Registered email |
| password | string | Yes | Account password |

## Responses
**200** - success; returns `data.user`, `data.sessionExpiresAt`, `data.Qalam_Token` and sets cookie.
**400** - validation. **401** - incorrect password. **403** - email not verified. **404** - user not found.

response.name: 401 - Unauthorized
403 - Forbidden

request.description:
## Purpose
Logs the user out by clearing the `Qalam_Token` cookie.

## Authentication
Not strictly required (no middleware), but normally called while logged in.

## Responses
**200** - `{"success": true, "message": "Logged out successfully"}`

## Purpose
Intended to rotate/refresh a token. Reads the `refreshToken` cookie.

> ⚠️ **Implementation note:** This endpoint is currently non-functional. It reads a cookie named `refreshToken` (which is never set), verifies against an undefined secret, and calls a non-existent `generateAccessToken()`. Expect a 401/500. It is documented for completeness.

response.name: 401 - Unauthorized

request.description:
## Purpose
Verifies an OTP. For `purpose=email_verification` it activates the account; for `purpose=forgot_password` it returns a `resetToken` used by Reset Password.

## Authentication
Not required.

## Request
| Field | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| email | string | Yes | Account email |
| otp | string | Yes | Exactly 6 digits |
| purpose | enum | Yes | `email_verification` or `forgot_password` |

## Responses
**200** - OTP verified (email) or returns `resetToken` (password). **400** - invalid/expired OTP or already verified.

response.name: 200 - Success

request.description:
## Purpose
Resends the OTP to the user's email. Rate-limited to once per minute.

## Authentication

| Field | Type | Req | Description |

| email | string | Yes | Account email |
| purpose | enum | Yes | `email_verification` or `forgot_password` |

## Responses
**200** - OTP resent. **400** - already verified. **404** - user not found. **429** - resend cooldown active.

response.name: 200 - Success

## Purpose

## Purpose

## Authentication
Required. **Role:** admin or instructor.

## Body (multipart)
Interests and objectives/requirements/tags accept comma-separated strings.
| Field | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| title.ar / title.en | text | Yes | Min 2, max 150 |
| description.ar / .en | text | Yes | Min 3, max 10000 |
| category | text | Yes | Category ObjectId |
| instructor | text | Yes | Instructor ObjectId |
| level | enum | Yes | beginner/intermediate/advanced |
| language | enum | Yes | arabic/english |
| price | text | Yes | >= 0 |
| discountPrice | text | No | <= price |
| duration | text | No | minutes >= 0 |
| requirements | text | Yes | comma-separated |
| objectives | text | Yes | comma-separated |
| tags | text | Yes | comma-separated |
| thumbnail | file | No | image <= 20MB |
| trailerVideo | file | No | video <= 20MB |

**201** - created. **400** - validation. **403** - wrong role. **404** - category/instructor missing. **409** - duplicate slug.
